Select IC50 activities against human Beta-secretase 1 (CHEMBL4822). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Inner join compound_structures to enforce SMILES presence. Filter target CHEMBL4822 and standard_type IC50. Filter to rows where pubmed_id or doi is not null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows (no deduplication). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
